eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

getConsentStatus(bytes32).details: EXPIRED is computed dynamically, no extra transaction is needed.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

registerConsent(bytes32,address,bytes32,.details: Checks-Effects-Interactions pattern: every check happens before         any storage write; there are no external calls.         The patient signs an EIP-712 message; the registrar submits the         transaction on behalf of the medical organisation.

params.consentHash: keccak256(canonicalDoc || salt). The salt is kept off-chain.
params.consentId: Unique identifier of the consent record.
params.signature: EIP-712 signature produced by the patient.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). Emits a {RoleRevoked} event if the calling account had `role` and this call successfully revoked it. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeConsent(bytes32).details: Revocation is irreversible: REVOKED -> ACTIVE is forbidden.         Authorization uses msg.sender (NOT tx.origin), so an intermediary         contract cannot revoke a consent on the patient's behalf.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

ADMIN_ROLE().notice: Администратор (в продакшене — multisig): управляет ролями         и может ставить контракт на паузу.

REGISTRAR_ROLE().notice: Регистратор медицинской организации — фиксирует согласие         от имени организации после проверки подписи пациента.

getConsentStatus(bytes32).notice: Return the effective consent status, taking expiry into account.

hashConsent(address,address,bytes32,uint.notice: Helper — compute the EIP-712 digest off-chain.

isConsentValid(bytes32,address,uint32).notice: Check that the consent is actually valid for a given organisation         and document version.

nonces(address).notice: пациент => текущий nonce для EIP-712 подписи

revokeConsent(bytes32).notice: Revoke an active consent. Callable by the patient only.

setRegistrar(address,bool).notice: Grant / revoke the registrar role. ADMIN_ROLE only.
